claim: On a benchmark of 12 views of Blood places with known identity and 6 views of our station each with one planted fault (with clean twins), GPT-6.2 Sol at high effort named 12/12, caught 4/6 faults and raised 0/17 false alarms, the only one to catch rails laid across a track; Terra names well (12/12 high) but catches 1/6; Luna, Haiku and Sonnet one-shot are useless for faults. Nobody caught chairs in the air or track through the hall.
evidence: projects/blood-city/experiments/critics/critic_bench.py, knowledge/blood/critic-bench/v1 (2026-11-19). Small samples: rerun score after adding views.
use: Use Sol at high effort for faults and naming, Terra as a cheap namer; mix in Blood's own frames as known-answer controls and trust a miss only when the controls of that kind were hit.

checked.how: Read knowledge/blood/critic-bench/v1/score.json: gpt-6.2-sol@high named 12/12, faults 4/6, false alarms 0/17, and is the only entry without rails_across among its missed faults; terra@high 12/12, 1/6; luna 0/6, luna@high 1/6, haiku 1/6, sonnet 1/6; every entry misses track_through_hall and chairs_in_air. projects/blood-city/experiments/critics/critic_bench.py exists. Worded as ours, with its small sample.
